author: agrubercms
body:
This PR introduces a new `GlobalParticleTransformerHLT` model targeting tau identification in the Phase-2 HLT menu. It is the prerequisite for the HLT path `HLT_DoubleMediumPFPuppiParTTauh30_eta2p1`, which will be introduced in an upcoming PR to CMSSW. 
The model architecture and performance was discussed in a TauAlgo meeting [here](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1697956/contributions/7164811/attachments/3304685/5912565/ParT_model_presentation.pdf). 

The model is based on the `GlobalParticleTransformerHLT` architecture as defined in the [b-hive](https://gitlab.cern.ch/cms-btv/b-hive) repository. The inputs are `hltAK4PFPUPPIJets`, the model considers global features of the jet, features of all individual PF candidates within the jets and secondary vertex features. The attention layer is built from the 4-vectors of the PF candidates and secondary vertices, while the jet global features enter the last layer of the network.
The model output is classification into 6 classes, including taus. 
```  
classes = {
        "b": ["label_b", "label_gbb", "label_bb", "label_leptonicb", "label_leptonicbc"],
        "c": ["label_c", "label_gcc", "label_cc"],
        "uds": ["label_ud", "label_s"],
        "g": ["label_g"],
        "taup": ["label_taup"],
        "taum": ["label_taum"],
}
```

Reference guidelines for reproducibility can be found below: 

### 1.  Prepare input files (using the [hltupler](https://gitlab.cern.ch/cms-btv/hltupler) framework) 
```
cmsrel CMSSW_15_1_0_pre1
cd CMSSW_15_1_0_pre1/src
git cms-init
cmsenv
scram b -j

mkdir BTVTools
cd BTVTools
git clone --branch 1510p1_rebase ssh://git@gitlab.cern.ch:7999/agruber/hltupler.git

./submit_all.sh
```
The list of input samples used for the training is available [here](https://gitlab.cern.ch/agruber/hltupler/-/blob/1510p1_rebase/samples.tsv?ref_type=heads).

### 2. Train the model (using the [b-hive](https://gitlab.cern.ch/cms-btv/b-hive) framework)
Follow the setup instructions:
```
git clone --branch hltParT ssh://git@gitlab.cern.ch:7999/agruber/b-hive.git
cd b-hive
mamba env create -n b_hive -f env.yml
mamba activate b_hive
source setup.sh
law index
```
Run the training task: 
```
law run TrainingTask --training-version moreFeatures_v2 \
 --config hlt_part_phase2_debug \
 --model-name GlobalParticleTransformerHLT \
 --dataset-version moreFeatures_v2 \
 --filelist train_moreSamples.txt --epochs 100 \
 --n-threads 2 --batch-size 256
```
Plot the ROC curve:
```
law run ROCCurveTask --training-version moreFeatures_v2 \
 --config hlt_part_phase2_debug \
 --model-name GlobalParticleTransformerHLT \
 --dataset-version moreFeatures_v2 \
 --filelist train_moreSamples.txt --test-filelist val_moreSamples.txt \
 --n-threads 2 --batch-size 256 --epochs 100 
 --test-dataset-version moreFeatures_test
```
Export the model: 
```
python convert_global.py output/TrainingTask/hlt_part_phase2_debug/moreFeatures_v2/moreFeatures_v2/GlobalParticleTransformerHLT/epochs_100/nominal/best_model.pt hlt_part_phase2_debug hltParTAK4_CMSSW15_082026.onnx
```
title: Add hltParticleTransformer model for new Phase-2 path HLT_DoubleMediumPFPuppiParTTauh30_eta2p1
